messages.content: 오늘 아침엔 조금 여유가 있었어요. 저는 보통 9시 30분에 일을 시작해서 그 전에 커피를 마시거든요.
A quiet start sounds nice. Are you working from home today?
Yes. I only go to the office on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so I can skip the commute today.
That must free up some time. Is the rest of your morning fairly quiet?
그건 아니에요. 월요일 정기회의에서는 Harbor 프로젝트를 다루는데, 준비할 게 좀 있네요.
Ah, so there's still some prep to do. Who manages Harbor?
Sera is the PM for Harbor. She usually keeps the discussion moving when we get stuck on small details.
That's a useful skill. Does Sera have a regular room for project meetings?
세라는 프로젝트 회의를 Orion Room에서 진행해요. 화이트보드가 커서 설명하기 편하대요.
A big whiteboard does help! Do you have another project meeting later in the week?
On Wednesdays, we meet about Cedar. I try to keep separate notes so I do not mix up the tasks.
That sounds sensible. Who is the PM for Cedar?
Cedar의 PM은 Min이에요. 진행 방식이 꽤 달라서 처음엔 적응하는 데 시간이 걸렸어요.
Different meeting styles can take some getting used to. How long do you like a routine meeting to last?
About 25 minutes is ideal for a routine meeting. After that, I start thinking about all the work waiting for me.
I get that! A short agenda might help keep things focused. Let's leave you some time to prepare.
오늘은 영어로 설계의 트레이드오프를 설명하는 연습을 하고 싶어요. 장점만 말하고 단점은 얼버무리게 되네요.
We can practice giving both sides clearly. Do you have a presentation coming up?
We have a quarterly demo coming up. Jun is the presenter this time, but I am helping with the preparation.
Helping behind the scenes still takes work. What feature is Jun going to show?
준이 소개할 기능은 검색 대시보드예요. 영어로는 search dashboard라고 부르는데, 설명을 짧게 하기가 어렵네요.
Maybe start with the problem it helps people solve. Where do you track the search dashboard work?
We track the search dashboard work on the Beacon board. I need to tidy up the open tasks before the rehearsal.
That should make rehearsal easier. Will anyone outside your team review the design?
네, 이번에 협업하는 해외 파트너사가 Northwind Studio예요. 자료도 영어로 준비해야 해요.
That gives you a good reason to practice. Who do you talk to at Northwind Studio?
Elena is our contact at Northwind Studio. She asks really useful questions, so I want to be ready.
Useful questions can make a review much better. How does Elena like to receive design materials?
Elena는 설계 검토할 때 주석이 달린 PDF를 선호해요. 화면을 왔다 갔다 하지 않아도 돼서 좋다더라고요.
That sounds practical. When do you usually make room for preparation like this?
I prepare my weekly work plan on Fridays. I will add some time for writing and rehearsing instead of hoping I can squeeze it in.
Putting it on the calendar sounds sensible. We can practice one part of your explanation next time.
오늘은 발표 준비 대신 코드를 좀 봤어요. 제가 맡은 고객 지원 개선 작업이 환불 자동화거든요.
A change of pace, then. Which repository do you use for refund automation?
The repository for refund automation is return-flow. I was about to open a pull request, but I wanted to check the branch first.
Good call to check before opening it. What is the default branch of return-flow?
return-flow의 기본 브랜치는 integration이에요. 저장소마다 달라서 가끔 헷갈려요.
I can see how that would happen. Is there another repository you switch to often?
Yes, ledger-core is for payment reconciliation, and its default branch is stable. I keep almost picking the wrong one.
Switching contexts can be surprisingly tiring. Is coding your main focus this week?
온콜도 같이 하고 있어요. 지금 제가 담당하는 서비스는 Atlas API라 알림이 오면 먼저 확인해야 해요.
That can interrupt your flow. Where do the Atlas API alerts come in?
Atlas API alerts go to ops-atlas. I keep that channel open while I work, even when things are quiet.
Makes sense to keep an eye on it. Is there a runbook handy in ops-atlas?
네, ops-atlas에서 쓰는 장애 대응 문서는 Runbooks/Atlas에 있어요. 급할 때 안 헤매게 미리 읽어두려고요.
Reading it while things are calm sounds wise. Do you have a teammate covering another service?
Hana is on call for Nova. We check in with each other, mostly to make sure we remember to take a break.
That sounds like a good way to look out for each other. I hope the rest of your shift stays quiet!
